name: alternate sprinter lunge
source_instructions: Step back into a deep lunge.
Drive your arms like a sprinter.

phases.label: Left reverse lunge and opposing arm drive
Right reverse lunge and opposing arm drive

interpretation: Two controlled reverse lunges alternate rear legs over five seconds. Feet start hip width. The rear foot steps 0.70m back, lands on the toe patch with heel raised, and lifts for the return. The front whole sole stays fixed during that half. Torso stays upright; the rear-leg-side arm drives forward, opposing the front leg, with relaxed curled fingers. Numeric range and timing are authored; source does not require knee contact with the floor. The rear knee remains clear of the floor.

correctives.runtime: Four compact additive standard glTF POSITION/NORMAL targets before linear skinning. Active rear-knee lunge target or active-side heel-touch shoulder target; all unrelated keys explicitly zero.
correctives.construction: One local CorrectiveSmooth20x1.0 target per mirrored diagnosed collar, C1 source domain, exact inverse LBS and C1 radial25mm cap. No runtime DQ or smoothing.
